##########################################################################
# TOPOLOGY FILE - FABELVASSDRAGET ("The Fable River System")
# Terje Sandø, pump-station work, July 2026.
#
# Purpose: a large, richly-connected stress test for the new PUMP node type,
# exercising RESERVOIR_GEOMETRY (not RESERVOIR_CURVE), SPILLWAY (not
# OVERFLOW_CURVE), UNIFORM_NORMALIZED_CURVE (not TURBINE_CURVE/PUMP_CURVE),
# multiple generators per powerstation, seasonal OUTLET_AUTO_QMIN together
# with a downstream CHANNEL QMIN shifted +2 days to account for the
# asymptotic lag of cascaded-linear-reservoir routing
##########################################################################

#######################################################################################
# HEISVERKET - PUMP. Source=TROLLDAMMEN(14), target=SKYFONNA(10)
NODE PUMP 0 HEISVERKET
PUMP_SOURCE_IDNR 14
PUMP_TARGET_IDNR 10
PUMP_INLET_MASL 193.0
MAX_DISCHARGE 15.0
HEADLOSSCOEF 0.045
STATIC_MOTOR_EFFICIENCY 0.97
PUMP_STARTSTOP 2.5
UNIFORM_NORMALIZED_CURVE 11
0.0	0
0.1	40
0.2	65
0.3	80
0.4	88
0.5	92
0.6	92
0.7	90
0.8	87
0.9	83
1.0	78
ENDNODE

# DUGGTJERN - high headwater tarn
NODE RESERVOIR 2 DUGGTJERN

RESERVOIR_GEOMETRY
WIDTH_M 220.5
LENGTH_M 300
THETA 30
BOTTOM_MASL 1100.0
# SPILLWAY downstream_idnr C L spillway_level_masl
SPILLWAY 5 1.5 15.0 1125.0
FAST_OVERFLOW FALSE
# OUTLET_HATCH downstream_idnr minQ maxQ hatch_masl
OUTLET_HATCH 3 0.0 2.0 1102.0
OUTLET_TUNNEL -9999
# OUTLET_AUTO_QMIN nr_periods downstream_idnr outlet_masl
OUTLET_AUTO_QMIN 2 5 1102.0
01.05 30.09 0.5
01.10 30.04 0.8
ENDNODE
